categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Taifu Pump Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of civil water pumps. Its main product lines include land pumps, small submersible pumps, well submersible pumps, circulation pumps, and energy-saving pumps. These products serve applications in agricultural irrigation, domestic water supply, deep well water lifting, livestock water supply, and hot water circulation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as asynchronous motor design, permanent magnet synchronous motors, water pump system pressure control, vacuum impregnation, human-machine interaction frequency control, and solar-powered pump systems. Production methods include automated winding for stators, CNC precision machining for components, and automated casting processes. The company also applies computer-aided design (CAD), computer-aided manufacturing (CAM), computational fluid dynamics (CFD), and modular standardized components to enhance product efficiency and reduce production cycles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Taifu Pump serves a global customer base including distributors and brand manufacturers across Asia, America, Europe, Africa, and Oceania. Key end markets include agricultural irrigation, residential water supply, industrial water lifting, livestock farming, and heating systems. Major customers include large distributors such as GAZI INTERNATIONAL in Bangladesh and others in the US, Korea, and Australia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant export sales globally. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in the United States, Russia, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Singapore, and a controlling stake in a company in Taizhou, China. Its products are sold in over 100 countries and regions worldwide, with export revenue accounting for over 80% of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Taifu Pump operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling water pumps and related components. It designs and produces core components in-house, including stators and rotors, ensuring quality control and cost efficiency. The company sources raw materials such as copper wire, silicon steel sheets, and stainless steel from suppliers but controls key production processes internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-efficiency, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly pump technologies. R&D efforts focus on developing permanent magnet synchronous motors, intelligent control systems, solar-powered pumps, and noise reduction technologies. It also emphasizes digitalization and automation in production, expanding product lines with new models such as high-speed deep well pumps and smart household pumps. The company maintains a strong patent portfolio and participates in industry standard development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of various water pump types and related accessories. The company mainly uses a buyout distribution sales model with a small portion of direct sales. It also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies but these are non-core. The sales are predominantly export-oriented, invoiced mostly in US dollars.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major international competitors include Grundfos (Denmark), Wilo (Germany), Pedrollo (Italy), and Lowara (Germany). Domestic competitors include LEO Group, Dayuan Pump, Junhe Pump, and Lingxiao Pump. Taifu Pump ranks fifth among Chinese water pump exporters and is recognized as a leading high-tech and specialized manufacturer with multiple provincial and national awards, positioning it as a strong player in the civil water pump market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 743 million, a 4.05% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12.65 million, a 76.35% decrease due to increased depreciation, interest expenses, and foreign exchange losses. The company has expanded production capacity from 1.2 million units in 2021 to 3.2 million units annually by 2024. Despite profit pressure from recent capacity expansion, the company expects profitability to improve as sales scale increases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taifu Pump emphasizes high-quality, energy-efficient, and technologically advanced water pumps with strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio. Its products feature compact design, high efficiency, low noise, and intelligent control, including solar-powered options for off-grid applications. The company leverages in-house core component manufacturing to ensure product reliability and cost competitiveness. Its global distribution network and strong brand recognition further differentiate it in the international market.
